title: Libpod/compat API RestartContainer defaults to 0 second timeout, overriding container StopTimeout
body:
### Issue Description

When using the compat API (e.g. `podman compose` with the `docker-compose` backend) the `restart` command ignores the container's `StopTimeout` value, replacing it with 0 if the caller did not specify a value. This results in containers being killed with an immediate `SIGKILL`. The `stop` command works as expected.

[containers_stop.go](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/e36e1a41c69ea9f6096ed628a71920f315f34514/pkg/api/handlers/compat/containers_stop.go#L42-L52) only sets `options.Timeout` from `query` (where values default to 0) if the argument appears to have been specified, [containers_restart.go](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/e36e1a41c69ea9f6096ed628a71920f315f34514/pkg/api/handlers/compat/containers_restart.go#L40-L46) instead sets `options.Timeout` from `query` fields without regard to whether the caller had set them.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. Write the following compose file:
```
services:
  test:
    image: docker.io/library/busybox
    command: sh -c "sleep inf"
```
2. Run compose (e.g. `podman compose -f compose.yaml up`)
3. In another shell, determine the PID of `sh` running inside the container. Then trace it using `strace -p $PID_HERE`
4. In another shell, use compose to restart the container (e.g. `podman compose -f compose.yaml restart test`)

### Describe the results you received

`strace` indicates the process was `killed by SIGKILL` immediately, without ever receiving `SIGTERM`.

### Describe the results you expected

The process should first receieve `SIGTERM` (`sleep` doesn't seem to exit on `SIGTERM`, so `SIGKILL` should be sent only after a delay)

comments.body: You have sorted out pretty much everything. I think you could turn this into a PR if interested.

-I have reproduced this on `6.1.0-dev`

Compat API restart without `t` returns 204 in ~0.3s on a container with --stop-timeout 5 that ignores `SIGTERM`. Compat stop without `t` takes ~5s. CLI restart without -t also takes ~5s.

```bash
falloficaruss@abhisheks-linux:~/podman$ time curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" -X POST \
  --unix-socket "$SOCK" http://d/v5.0.0/containers/rtest-29276/restart
HTTP 204

real    0m0.255s
user    0m0.005s
sys     0m0.004s
```
```bash
falloficaruss@abhisheks-linux:~/podman$ $PODMAN start rtest-29276 2>/dev/null || \
  $PODMAN run -d --name rtest-29276 --stop-timeout 5 --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
    docker.io/library/busybox sh -c 'trap "" TERM; sleep 1000'
time curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" -X POST \
  --unix-socket "$SOCK" http://d/v5.0.0/containers/rtest-29276/stop
rtest-29276
WARN[0050] StopSignal SIGTERM failed to stop container rtest-29276 in 5 seconds, resorting to SIGKILL
HTTP 204

real    0m5.177s
user    0m0.006s
sys     0m0.006s
```

I can produce a PR if assigned to me.
This appears to also affect the HTTP libpod API
